name: Adzviser eBay
description:
Connect your eBay seller data to Claude. No more exporting CSVs or uploading files, Adzviser brings your reporting data directly into the conversation.

Ask about order totals and quantities. Compare listings, dig into inventory and seller standards, and understand what's changed over time. Whether you're checking yesterday's sales or putting together a monthly report, start with a question and let Claude build the analysis you need.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Adzviser eBay to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Adzviser eBay to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ebay.mcp.adzviser.com/http. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Adzviser eBay MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser eBay provides these MCP tools: list_metrics_and_breakdowns_ebay, list_workspace, and retrieve_reporting_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Adzviser eBay?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Adzviser eBay in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Adzviser eBay MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser eBay requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Adzviser eBay is developed by Adzviser LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
